description: PHASE 2 SLICE 3 — Follow-request flow for private accounts + keyword/mute-word feed filtering. Implements the pending->accepted follow lifecycle against the FEAT-002 follows.status contract (a follow of a private account is created 'pending'; the followee accepts/denies; only 'accepted' grants visibility), consuming the NotificationType.followRequest already modeled and produced by the migration 0002/0003 triggers. Adds a RelationshipRepository (ChangeNotifier singleton, MockData fallback + guarded persistence) owning the viewer's follow edges and the incoming pending follow-requests, exposing follow()/unfollow() (status decided by target.isPrivate), and acceptFollowRequest()/denyFollowRequest(). Wires the currently-dead 'Follow' button on profile_screen.dart to real follow state (Follow / Requested / Following) and adds an accept/deny UI on follow_request notifications in notifications_screen.dart. ALSO adds keyword/mute-word filtering — a deliberate product differentiator: SafetyRepository (or RelationshipRepository) gains a persisted-in-memory mute-words list and PostRepository hides posts whose content matches any mute word (case-insensitive, whole-word-ish), managed from a Settings 'Muted words' screen. All new pure logic (status decision, request state machine, mute-word matching) is unit-tested on the mock path.
steps: Repository: create lib/data/relationship_repository.dart — a ChangeNotifier singleton `RelationshipRepository.instance` seeded from MockData (add MockData.followEdges() and MockData.pendingFollowRequests() small seeds; the existing notifications seed already contains a followRequest from citydesk which the requests UI can reflect). Model a follow edge minimally (followee id + status 'pending'|'accepted') and an incoming request (actor UserProfile + createdAt). Expose synchronous getters: `FollowState followStateFor(String userId)` returning an enum {none, requested, following}; `List<UserProfile> pendingRequests()` (unmodifiable, newest-first). Mutators: `void follow(UserProfile target)` — if target.isPrivate create a 'pending' edge (state=requested) else an 'accepted' edge (state=following), optimistic + single notify + guarded persistence inserting into public.follows with follower=auth.uid(), followee=target.id, status accordingly (mirror _persistLike guard pattern); `void unfollow(String userId)` deletes the edge (guarded delete on public.follows); `void acceptFollowRequest(String actorId)` / `void denyFollowRequest(String actorId)` — accept flips the incoming follow row to status='accepted' (guarded update on public.follows where follower=actorId and followee=auth.uid()), deny deletes it; both remove the request from the pending list optimistically with a single notify. Add guarded load() hydrating the viewer's follow edges (follows where follower=auth.uid()) and incoming pending requests (follows where followee=auth.uid() and status='pending'), mock fallback. Document the follows.status contract from migration 0002 in the file doc comment.

UI — follow button: wire the previously-dead 'Follow' OutlinedButton in lib/screens/profile_screen.dart (_ProfileHeader, when NOT current user) to RelationshipRepository: label reflects followStateFor(profile.id) => 'Follow' (none) / 'Requested' (requested) / 'Following' (following); tapping follows (Follow->Requested for private, Follow->Following for public) or unfollows (Following/Requested -> Follow) via follow()/unfollow(). Reflect target.isPrivate: a private account shows a lock affordance and, when not accepted, its posts/tab content are gated with a 'This account is private' empty-state (client-side gate consistent with server can_view_profile; document that the server is the true gate).

UI — accept/deny requests: in lib/screens/notifications_screen.dart, render NotificationType.followRequest entries with Accept / Deny buttons wired to RelationshipRepository.acceptFollowRequest/denyFollowRequest(actor.id). On accept, optionally surface that they now follow you; on deny, remove the row. Handle the empty state (no pending requests). Keep the existing notifications list rendering + markNotificationsRead behavior intact (do not weaken profile_repository_test.dart notification assertions).

Keyword / mute-word filtering (product differentiator): add a persisted-in-memory mute-words list (choose a single owning repository — SafetyRepository from FEAT-006 is the natural home; if FEAT-006's SafetyRepository exists, extend it, else place on RelationshipRepository) with getters `List<String> muteWords`, mutators addMuteWord(String)/removeMuteWord(String) (trimmed, lowercased, de-duped, single notify, idempotent). Add a pure matcher `bool contentMatchesMuteWords(String content, Set<String> words)` (case-insensitive; match on word boundaries so 'art' does not hide 'startup' — a simple regex or tokenized compare, documented). Extend the PostRepository feed filter (from FEAT-006's filterHidden or a composed pure helper) to ALSO drop posts whose content matches a mute word, keeping identity behavior on empty word sets and preserving order + the repo contract. Do not break existing post_repository_test.dart.

UI — Settings 'Muted words': add lib/screens/muted_words_screen.dart reachable from SettingsScreen (FEAT-005): a list of current mute words with add (text field + validation: non-empty, reasonable max length) and remove affordances, empty-state, and live update via AnimatedBuilder on the owning repository. Wire the Privacy & Safety section entry point placeholder from FEAT-005/006 to this screen.

Tests: add test/relationship_repository_test.dart (pure, no Supabase): follow() on a public target yields FollowState.following and on a private target yields FollowState.requested (single notify each; idempotent); unfollow() returns to none; acceptFollowRequest removes the pending request and (state) and notifies once; denyFollowRequest removes it; pendingRequests() is newest-first + unmodifiable. Add test/mute_words_test.dart: contentMatchesMuteWords is case-insensitive, respects word boundaries (matches 'art' in 'the art show' but not in 'startup'), and empty word set matches nothing; addMuteWord/removeMuteWord normalize+dedupe+notify-once-on-change. Extend the pure feed-filter tests to cover mute-word hiding without weakening existing repo tests.

Update README.md Backend/Client section: document the Phase 2 client wiring — private-account toggle, block/mute/report, the follow-request pending->accepted flow, and keyword mute-word filtering — and reiterate the live-Supabase-unverified environment risk (RLS/can_view_profile/follow-accept trigger enforcement) for these features. Run verification; ensure no NEW analyzer issues and all tests green; discard the tooling exclude block in analysis_options.yaml before finishing.

Regression guard: confirm ProfileRepository/PostRepository/CommentRepository existing tests all pass UNCHANGED and the new singletons default to empty relationship/mute-word/safety sets so no existing feed/notification assertion shifts.

findings: IMPLEMENTATION. (1) lib/data/relationship_repository.dart — new ChangeNotifier singleton RelationshipRepository.instance. Owns outgoing follow edges (Map<followeeId, FollowState>) and incoming pending FollowRequest list, seeded from new MockData.followEdges() (empty) + MockData.pendingFollowRequests() ([citydesk], mirroring the existing followRequest notification seed). Pure top-level followStateForNewFollow(target) decides status by target.isPrivate (private=>requested, public=>following). Synchronous getters followStateFor(userId) and pendingRequests() (unmodifiable, newest-first). Mutators follow()/unfollow()/acceptFollowRequest()/denyFollowRequest() are optimistic, single-notify, idempotent, with guarded fire-and-forget persistence to public.follows (upsert with status by isPrivate; delete on unfollow; update status='accepted' on accept where follower=actorId AND followee=auth.uid(); delete on deny). Guarded load() hydrates outgoing edges (follower=auth.uid()) and incoming pending requests (followee=auth.uid() AND status='pending', joining profiles via follows_follower_fkey), mock fallback preserved. Migration-0002 follows.status contract documented in the file doc comment. (2) lib/data/safety_repository.dart — EXTENDED (FEAT-006) with mute-words: normalized (trim+lowercase+dedupe) in-memory set seeded from MockData.muteWords() (empty), getters muteWords (sorted, unmodifiable) + muteWordSet, mutators addMuteWord/removeMuteWord (single-notify, idempotent, ignore empty). New PURE contentMatchesMuteWords(content, words): case-insensitive, word-boundary via RegExp('\\b'+RegExp.escape(word)+'\\b') so 'art' matches 'the art show' but NOT 'startup'; empty set matches nothing. Composed into the existing pure filterHidden via an optional muteWords param that preserves identity-on-empty (all three sets empty => same instance returned). PostRepository._visible() now passes safety.muteWordSet. (3) UI: profile_screen.dart Follow button (previously onPressed:(){}) wired to RelationshipRepository — label Follow/Requested/Following, lock affordance for private-not-accepted, tapping follow()/unfollow(); private accounts gate tab content behind a new _PrivateAccountGate 'This account is private' empty-state until FollowState.following (UX mirror of server can_view_profile). notifications_screen.dart renders Accept/Deny on NotificationType.followRequest tiles wired to accept/deny (shows 'Request handled' once no longer pending); listens to RelationshipRepository too; existing list + markNotificationsRead behavior untouched. New lib/screens/muted_words_screen.dart (add field w/ maxLength=maxMuteWordLength=60 + validation, remove, empty-state, AnimatedBuilder on SafetyRepository) wired from settings_screen.dart Privacy & Safety section. (4) MockData gained followEdges() + pendingFollowRequests(); muteWords() left empty. VERIFICATION: env vars exported; flutter pub get OK; flutter analyze reports ONLY the 8 known baseline INFO lints (exit 0, no NEW issues); flutter test passes 118/118 (baseline was 90; added relationship_repository_test.dart, mute_words_test.dart, plus mute-word cases). analysis_options.yaml auto-appended exclude block discarded via git checkout (not committed). Existing post_repository_test.dart / profile_repository_test.dart / safety_repository_test.dart pass UNCHANGED — new singletons default to empty relationship/mute-word sets so no feed/notification assertion shifted. ENVIRONMENT RISK (UNVERIFIED live Supabase): no reachable/administerable Supabase and no service-role key, so follows.status pending->accepted transitions, can_view_profile enforcement for private accounts (the client private-account gate and the mute filter are OPTIMISTIC UX mirrors; the server is the true gate), and the follow-accept notification trigger (migration 0003) are NOT exercised here. All persistence is guarded and no-ops cleanly offline. No new migration needed (follows.status + trigger exist in 0002/0003); no new pub packages added. === V1 REVIEW FIXES (2026-09-08-121218-review.md, NEEDS_CHANGES) === (Issue 2 — RelationshipRepository.load() over-notifies) Added a notify-only-on-real-change guard to load() mirroring SafetyRepository.load()'s setEquals: after building newEdges/newRequests from the live rows, load() now computes edgesUnchanged = mapEquals(newEdges, _edges) and requestsUnchanged = _requestsEqual(newRequests, _requests) and returns EARLY (no clear, no refill, no notifyListeners) when both hold, so a hydrate that matches the current cache no longer triggers a redundant rebuild. _requestsEqual is a new private static helper that compares the two request lists order-insensitively, keyed by actor id with the createdAt included (a re-order alone is not a change, but an added/removed/moved request or a shifted timestamp is). mapEquals/setEquals come from the already-imported package:flutter/foundation.dart. This path is live-only (load() no-ops offline because currentUser is null in tests), so the behavior is exercised structurally; added test/relationship_repository_test.dart 'load (guarded, offline)' asserting load() is a no-op that never throws and fires ZERO notifications offline while leaving the mock seed intact — documenting the guard's offline contract. (Issue 3 — private-account feed gate asymmetry) DEFERRED by design and documented: the client private-account gate lives on the profile screen as a UX mirror of the SECURITY DEFINER can_view_profile helper; feed-level privacy is enforced server-side (a private account's posts are excluded from the feed query for non-accepted followers). Mirroring that gate client-side in filterHidden would require the client to know each author's follow-acceptance state for the whole feed, duplicating server authz that cannot be verified here (no reachable Supabase) and risking divergence; the server remains the true gate. Left as a documented, accepted risk rather than adding a partial client mirror.
